Data.Recommendedapproach: Approve the draft with the ticket owner assigned, then check the original Software Request record to identify whether it is waiting on Owen’s manager approval or a new-vendor security review. If it is under $500/year, KB says it routes to the manager; nudge the manager or procurement owner as appropriate and add an internal note with the current approver. Verify whether the diagram tool is already in Company Portal’s Approved list and whether the vendor is new, because KB cites a 5-business-day security review only for new vendors. KB is silent on personal-card purchase reimbursement for software, so do not authorize expense reimbursement without Finance/Procurement confirmation.
Data.Subject: Software request stuck three weeks - unacceptable
Data.Body: My request for the diagram tool has been sitting in approval for three weeks with zero updates. This is unacceptable for a $200 license. If it isn't sorted by Friday I'll buy it on my own card and expense it.
Data.Rationale: This is a frustrated software license request delay, not a full work stoppage, so Software/Low fits. SupportKB confirms under-$500 software requests route to the manager, new-vendor security review takes 5 business days, and installs outside Company Portal are blocked. KB does not state whether personal-card purchases for software licenses are reimbursable or allowed, so the draft avoids promising or denying reimbursement.
Data.Draftreply:
Hi Owen,

I’m sorry your diagram tool request has been sitting in approval for three weeks with no updates. I am taking ownership of this ticket and escalating it today so we can find where the approval is stuck.

For software that is not already in the Company Portal Approved list, the standard path is:
1. Submit a Software Request in the IT catalog with the business justification.
2. Requests under $500/year route to your manager for approval.
3. If it is a new vendor, security review takes 5 business days.

Please do not install software from the open internet on a company laptop; installs outside Company Portal are blocked by policy and generate a security alert.

We’ll review the pending approval path for your request and update you with the next step.

Regards,
HomeFix Supply Support Team
